summary: She came back, and what she came back with is the worst thing she has said in four months. After a week in which ALTR sent her two messages, volume recovered from 4 to 22 and her own messages from 2 to 9 — but the substance of her re-engagement is a structured, unemotional indictment of the Instagram service. On Aug 30 Mayson opened the week by re-sending the same content Drive link Michelle first sent on 2026-05-07 and imposing a new quota — '7 reels a week so 30 in total per month', fresh content only. She got two links and 'Working on it!!' — no followers, no views, no reach. Everything else carried in from last week aged another seven days untouched. Zero of eleven overdue items moved. Derrek: silent since a two-word tag on Aug 21 (14 days), last substantive message Aug 1 (34 days) — his Meta-rep money question is now 33 days old, exactly as last week's state file predicted. Ollie Mckinlay: silent since Aug 20 (15 days) with five open items, including Wesley's anniversary sends now 24 and 21 days past with still no confirmation anywhere in the chat, and her own three customs 12 days past the 'Sunday 23rd' she committed to, never chased. health.rationale: Down 3 from 48. Engagement recovered — 22 messages against 4, her own from 2 to 9 — and on volume alone this would be an up week. It is not, because the content of the re-engagement is a worse position on the churn curve than the silence it replaced. Last week's read was 'she is not angry, she is absent'; this week she is present, specific and comparing us to another agency. The Sept 2 message is the first time in 128 days she has (a) quantified our performance against her own ('roughly 150 views per post'), (b) cited a competitor's result on the identical brief ('around 40k followers'), and (c) asked for the people doing the work to be replaced ('could you maybe have someone specifically focusing on my two additional accounts?'). It is the fifth escalation of the same growth/marketing complaint — May 20, Jun 2, Jun 4, Jul 21 and now Sept 2, 92 days from the first substantive one — and each cycle has gone unanswered on substance. Against that: zero of the eleven carried overdue items were touched. Wesley's anniversary sends are 24 and 21 days unconfirmed; Derrek's Meta-rep money answer is 33 days and he has not typed a substantive word to this client since Aug 1; Ollie has been silent 15 days with five open items; her own three customs are 12 days past her date and nobody chased. Mica's return was a single link plus a lecture about consistent posting aimed at a client whose complaint is that WE are not consistent — worse than sending nothing. Stephski missed the Aug 31 withdrawal reminder that correlates with every clean payment cycle. What holds this at 45 rather than the mid-30s is real and should not be discounted: Mayson answered her '@mmayson ?' in 15 minutes, escalated to a call rather than another one-line reply, and got a date in the diary; the invoice went out on time; the leak-removal report held; and her tone is still constructive rather than hostile ('I genuinely think there’s a lot of potential there that we’re currently missing' is a client trying to fix it, not leave).
